discovery.auth: HTTP Basic — username = customer e-mail, password = API token from MY ACCOUNT (sandbox token from sandbox.b2b.vidaxl.com)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (vidaXL B2B order API + feeds) Confidence: **high** — official developer docume
auth: 1. Tenant subscribes on dropxl.com and picks a selling country
2. API token under MY ACCOUNT on b2b.vidaxl.com (sandbox: e-mail dropshipment@vidaxl.com)

endpoints.purpose: products, images, prices, stock — stock hourly, price daily
order status (1 temporary … 5 sent with tracking number + URL, 7 cancelled, 8 refunded)

reference.limits: Maximum 1 request per second. - Orders are not payable via API — pay in 'Unsubmitted orders' in the portal - Ship only to the account's registered countries - Product must be active in the offer feed

fields.name: email
fields.help: The vidaXL B2B customer e-mail (HTTP Basic username).

fields.name: api_token
fields.help: API token shown under MY ACCOUNT on b2b.vidaxl.com (HTTP Basic password). Sandbox tokens belong to https://sandbox.b2b.vidaxl.com, which this server does not switch to.

me.note: vidaXL has no account endpoint; the probe reads one product with the Basic credentials, so `account` is empty on success. Limit 1 request/second.

list_products.note: GET /api_customer/products?limit&offset: the products you may sell [{id, name, code (SKU), category_path, quantity, price, created_at, updated_at}] (up to 500 per request). quantity and price are decimal strings (list_price, quantity). `query` and `category` are not accepted. `id` is the SKU code used in orders.

get_product.note: GET /api_customer/products?code_eq={SKU}: a one-element array; an unknown SKU is an empty array (invalid_input). Images, descriptions and full prices are in the offer feed, not the API.

create_order.note: POST /api_customer/orders. 'Order payment is not available via API. All the accepted orders are available in Unsubmitted orders' and must be paid on b2b.vidaxl.com. `shipping_address` is the addressbook {name, address (max 30 chars, with a number), address2, city, province (required for US/AU), postal_code, country (ISO-2), phone, comments}; `items` are order_products [{product_code, quantity}] (an item may carry its own addressbook). customer_order_reference is a fresh UUID. `shipping_option` is not sent.

get_order.note: GET /api_customer/orders?id_eq={id}: [{order: {id, status_order_id, status_order_name (Temporary, Submitted, Being Prepared, Sent, Cancelled, Refunded, Replaced), submitted_at, gross_total, shipping_tracking, shipping_tracking_url, order_products}}]; tracking number and URL appear at status 5 (Sent). Totals are decimal strings.

not_offered.quote_shipping: The order API has no shipping-quote endpoint (only create order, get orders, invoices and products are documented).
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint; shipping_tracking and shipping_tracking_url are part of the order record (see get_order).

evidence: host b2b.vidaxl.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
